# Shadekin
Fluffy folks with a deep connection to The Dark — a parallel space they can occasionally slip into.
## Ability Differences
- Need no air to survive. - Can Shadeskip — a short-range blink. - Can travel to and from The Dark at will, dimming nearby lights while there. - When too low on energy, they may fall into a powerful sleep until they recover. - Can "speak" via Empathy that only other Shadekin can understand. - Less cold damage, slightly more heat damage. - Near no cellular damage. - More bloodloss and radiation damage.
## Physical Differences
- Very large and brightly colored eyes with no pupils. - Sees the world through their eyes' tint. - Very large ears, very fluffy build. - Can be Male, Female, or Unsexed. - Can be 18-300 years old.
